about_the_game:
"Postcards are great, but I... I wanted to see the real things with my own two eyes."

 - Story -

Experience the story of Kaelyn Kirena, who more than anything has always dreamed of traveling the world with her best friends at her side.
Unfortunately, fate hasn't been kind to Kay, and she was stricken partially blind by a strange, uncurable, and debilitating illness.
Day after day, her eyesight continues to worsen and she's starting to lose hope that she'll ever get to see the beautiful sights depicted in the postcards that she's collected since she was a child.

That was, until one day...

One day, her friends decided to take a chance.
They all gathered up what money and resources they could for the sole mission of using it all to help their dear friend fulfill their lifelong wish -- to see the world, and all of the magnificent sights that it provides.

This grand journey across this wonderful planet of ours is set to begin.
The question is, will you be joining these friends on their big adventure?
It's time to go out and see the world!


- Features -

  • Travel the world with a colorful cast of characters, each with their own unique personalities and motivations!

  • Immerse yourself in custom created backgrounds and musical tracks that help set the tone for the many locations that you'll be visiting on your journey. (Kay has quite the extensive postcard collection!)

  •  While you're out exploring the world, uncover the strange family mystery that surrounds Kay and discover just what makes this small, but strong girl so special.

  • Pick your traveling companion and grow your relationship with your chosen friend as your travels take you further. Will your relationship evolve into something more than just being childhood friends?

  • Over 20+ hours of content, with multiple routes and endings to explore!

  • Full screen Windows HDR support

Thank you for checking out our game!
